purpose: NAB is an already exposed development benchmark. Improve design using documented development iterations; select each series' parameters only from training/background and injected validation. Freeze final implementation before reading the new UCR test labels.
split: unchanged first40% train, next20% validation, last40% development-test

injection.shape: six local flatlines at training median +/- 3*noise; duration as long suite; outside original injection region all original values retained
injection.duration_limit: at most half the distance to the next injection start, leaving a recovery interval

selection: maximize mean event F2 across short/long/flatline suites subject to both point budgets and background events <= max(1, validation days / 14); observed-order-statistic quantiles (higher) respect finite-sample point quotas, then mean recall, then lower outside-injection alarm fraction, then lower background alarm fraction, then higher threshold. If no injection-tail-feasible candidate, minimize tail excess among background-feasible candidates, then maximize mean F2. Never use real anomaly labels.

candidate_evidence.routing: training lag correlation >= .5 -> periodic; otherwise robust_ar; no selection between bases using injection fit
candidate_evidence.autoregressive_context: signed geometric mean of absolute AR innovation z and rolling-level z, each with a training-derived scale floor
candidate_evidence.scale_floor: training median of emitted scale * 0.5, frozen before validation
candidate_evidence.channel_normalization: 99th percentile of absolute channel scores on unmodified validation background, with 1e-8 floor

reference_algorithms: periodic_point and periodic_robust_ewma (span12/cap4), without learned evidence floor or normalizer; thresholds calibrated under the identical current protocol
ucr_holdout_admission: official archive, all id%5==0 with n<=100000, train_end>=2048 and finite values; no filtering by labels, periodicity or performance
ucr_split: first80% of official train prefix is fit; final20% of official train prefix is validation; official remainder is held-out test; filenames' last two anomaly indices not parsed before final freeze
ucr_metrics: strict top1 localization on test; auxiliary top1 expands each boundary by max(100, anomaly length) samples and is not the primary score; one-based annotation sensitivity is separate; calibrated event/FPR results use sample gap max(1,P//16). Exact definitions are frozen in configs/ucr-evaluation.json.
